newsitem.title: USA: In Focus sees Q4 results above estimates.
newsitem.headline: In Focus sees Q4 results above estimates.

text.p: In Focus Systems Inc said Wednesday it expects revenues and earnings to come in ahead of fourth quarter Street estimates.
It attributed its projection to continued strong demand and improved profitability.
Wall Street puts the company's fourth quarter earnings at $0.36 per share, according to First Call figures.

The company said revenues should exceed analysts' range of estimates for the quarter by about 10 percent, contributing to increased profitability exceeding analysts' range of estimates by about 20 percent.
The company plans to release final year-end numbers January 23.
